description: This file defines the MimeType class within the GuzzleHttp PSR7 package, providing methods to determine MIME types based on file extensions or filenames.

classes.name: MimeType
classes.description: A final class providing static methods to map file extensions and filenames to MIME types.

methods.name: fromFilename
methods.description: Determines the MIME type of a file based on its filename extension.

methods.name: fromExtension
methods.description: Maps a given file extension to its corresponding MIME type.
